title: Fixed the `rowHeaderWidth` option ignoring values passed as strings. Both `rowHeaderWidth` and `columnHeaderHeight` now accept a pixel size written as a string, either as a bare number (`'100'`) or with the unit (`'100px'`), in the scalar and the per-level array form alike. A value that states no pixel count, such as `'50%'` or `'20em'`, is ignored in favor of the default size and reported once in the console.
